prompt: what do you know about Tassar Silk of West Singbhum district. explain in detail about its speciality, capability, shortcomings and strategy to develop and scale silk with respect to domestic and export market potential. Give facts and figures also.. write a concept proposal on the same topic defining the pointers adn sub pointers. write the paper in ellaborated details with number. facts and figures.
judge_reasoning: Candidate [1] most closely matches the full prompt scope (speciality, shortcomings, domestic/export scaling strategy, and a numbered concept proposal) and includes multiple “facts and figures,” but it is truncated mid-way through the timeline, which is a major completeness defect. Candidates [2] and [4] contain a severe core factual mistake by identifying Tasar silk as Eri silk (including associated silkworm/feeding details), which undermines the credibility of the rest of their content even though they are well-structured. Candidate [3] is complete and well-structured with appropriate numbered pointers/sub-pointers, but it largely omits the requested facts and figures, reducing its usefulness for the “facts and figures also” requirement.
